newsitem.title: USA: Extend ethanol tax breaks to 2007, US senators ask.
newsitem.headline: Extend ethanol tax breaks to 2007, US senators ask.

text.p: The federal fuel tax brreak for ethanol should be extended through 2007, leaders of the Senate Agriculture Committee said Thursday in a letter to the head of the Senate's tax-writing panel.
The Finance Committee was to "mark up" a spending bill throughout the day.

In their letter, the Agriculture chairman Richard Lugar, Indiana Republican, and Iowan Tom Harkin, the top Democrat on the panel, said ethanol incentives should be available to biomass. Ethanol now gets a 5.4 cent a gallon break on fuel taxes as well as an income tax credit for small producers.
